snippet.title: Destabilized | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Sometimes hard choices have to be made for Science! 

In Destabilized, players will engage in some friendly, in-office rivalry, jostling up the corporate ladder, making sure that you're at the top of the game. While visiting the station, you might have to push your coworkers down the stairs, or sacrifice them, for science in this upcoming co-op title.

Remember–you and your team's performance will be evaluated by the GeoDesX corporation!

*or don't

Get in line for your Aptitude Test, by wishlisting today!
